people.name: Bani
people.line: A Levite who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Hashabiah
people.line: A Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Rehum
people.line: A Levite who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem

translations.web: After him, the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
translations.bsb: Next to him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani, and next to him, Hashabiah, ruler of a half-district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
translations.kjv: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
translations.asv: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, for his district.
